propositions: pytest-xdist worker process crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' when running test_matching_guard_is_accepted on Python 3.11, blocking CI gate
asyncio.wait_for on Python 3.11 consumes external cancellation when its child completes in the same event-loop turn, leaving the worker task in cancelling state and parked at queue.get()
crash is reproducible only on py3.11 and only under CPU/memory contention at xdist teardown, but does not occur on py3.12+
fix replaces asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=...) with async context asyncio.timeout(...) to restore correct cancellation semantics
regression tests added by commit 8c9bf5d78d verify worker task completes despite job completion race and respects shutdown cancellation
